content.title: Short-Term Rental (STR) Permit Application in Arvada, CO
content.summary: To operate a short-term rental in Arvada, you must obtain both a short-term rental permit and a business license. The application requires submission of ownership proof, property diagrams, maintenance plans, inspection forms, insurance proof, and neighborhood notifications.

steps.title: Prepare Required Materials
steps.text: Gather all required documents including proof of property ownership, a detailed property diagram or floor plan, a written property maintenance plan, a completed STR Property Inspection Form signed by a certified home inspector within 30 days prior to application, proof of a valid City of Arvada business license, proof of insurance with at least $1 million liability coverage, and a notarized neighborhood notification letter.

steps.title: Apply for Business License
steps.text: Obtain a valid City of Arvada business license through the City’s online licensing and tax system, MUNIRevs.

steps.title: Submit STR Permit Application
steps.text: Apply online via the City's permitting system. Create a public account if you do not already have one. Submit all required documents including the inspection form and proof of neighborhood notification.

steps.title: Neighborhood Notification
steps.text: Notify the owner or tenant of each lot sharing a property line with the STR property by first class U.S. mail within 14 days of permit issuance. Submit notarized proof of this notification with your application.

steps.title: Application Review
steps.text: The City of Arvada will review the completed application for compliance. Reviews typically take 10 business days.

required_documents.name: Proof of Ownership
required_documents.description: Copy of recorded deed, notarized letter attesting ownership interest as defined in Arvada Land Development Code section 11-3-3-1, or proof of being a named beneficiary of a trust owning the property.

required_documents.name: Property Diagram or Floor Plan
required_documents.description: Diagram showing all floors, room uses, door locations, egress window locations and sizes, fire extinguisher locations, and smoke and carbon monoxide detector locations.

required_documents.name: Property Maintenance Plan
required_documents.description: Written plan including lawn mowing, weed removal, snow and ice removal, rubbish and garbage removal, and trash hauling service contact information.

required_documents.name: STR Property Inspection Form
required_documents.description: Form signed by a third-party Certified Home Inspector (ASHI, InterNACHI, or Certified Master Inspector) within 30 days prior to application.
required_documents.where_to_get: Download Property Inspection Form from City website

required_documents.name: City of Arvada Business License
required_documents.description: Valid business license obtained through the City’s online licensing and tax system, MUNIRevs.

required_documents.name: Proof of Insurance
required_documents.description: Liability insurance with at least $1 million coverage for the use of the property as a short-term rental or proof that hosting platform provides this coverage.

required_documents.name: Neighborhood Notification Letter
required_documents.description: Letter notifying owners or tenants of adjacent lots, sent by first class U.S. mail within 14 days of permit issuance, with notarized proof of notice submitted.
required_documents.where_to_get: Download Neighborhood Notification letter template from City website

form_fields.label: Proof of Ownership
form_fields.description: Document showing ownership interest in the property as defined by the Arvada Land Development Code.
form_fields.why_needed: To verify applicant's legal right to operate STR on the property.

form_fields.label: Property Diagram or Floor Plan
form_fields.description: Diagram showing layout and safety features of the property.
form_fields.why_needed: To ensure the property meets safety and use requirements.

form_fields.label: Property Maintenance Plan
form_fields.description: Plan for lawn care, snow removal, and trash management.
form_fields.why_needed: To maintain property standards and neighborhood quality.

form_fields.label: STR Property Inspection Form
form_fields.description: Inspection form signed by certified home inspector within 30 days prior to application.
form_fields.why_needed: To confirm property safety and compliance.

form_fields.label: City of Arvada Business License
form_fields.description: Valid business license number obtained through MUNIRevs.
form_fields.why_needed: Required to legally operate a business in Arvada.

form_fields.label: Proof of Insurance
form_fields.description: Documentation of liability insurance coverage of at least $1 million.
form_fields.why_needed: To protect against liability related to STR operations.

form_fields.label: Neighborhood Notification Proof
form_fields.description: Notarized proof that neighbors were notified by mail within 14 days of permit issuance.
form_fields.why_needed: To ensure neighbors are informed of STR operations.
